title: Refinement List - Shows wrong items when 'Show More' is enabled.
body: **Describe the bug 🐛** It appears that the start index of items to display on a refinement list when 'Show More' is enabled is not at the top of the items list. Rather near the middle or even bottom. **To Reproduce 🔍** View an example of this bug at my JSFiddle. https://jsfiddle.net/jandk4014/aq9Laaew/234880/. It wouldn't make sense for me to add my code to this ticket. **Expected behavior 💭** The expected result for this refinement list would be to start with the first item in the list. In this example if would be 1/8". However, as you can see it's starting near the bottom of the listed items. **Screenshots 🖥** What I currently show. It shows 4 (1/4") as the first item. This is incorrect. With the list fully expanded you can see that 1/8" is at the top of the list and should be shown as such.
